thread:
maya: FYI postmortem uploaded — summary: cross-region routing bug + DNS TTL churn caused TLS handshake retries and a short outage in eu-west-1 -> us-east-2 path.

dan: saw the spike in SYN_RECV on the load balancers, good catch. link to report?

maya: https://redwood-internal/pms/248012 — please read section 2 (sequence) and 4 (action items).

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-048; severity lowered to P2 after rollback. :white_check_mark:

eli: quick question — root cause was NAT gateway conntrack exhaustion or our route sync? the doc says a routing diff and DNS TTL interplay.

maya: short answer: a routing rule flip with an overlapping prefix + aggressive DNS TTL (30s) caused clients to re-resolve while dataplane was mid-convergence. some LB backends returned TLS alerts during handshake retry storms.

dan: action items we discussed in triage: 1) Add temporary DNS TTL bump to 300s for affected prefixes (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 3h) 2) Rollback faulty route rule (owner: dan, ETA: 1h) 3) Add guard to routing controller to prevent overlapping prefix publishes (owner: eli, ETA: 2d) 4) Expand conntrack table on gateway fleet (owner: infra-team, ETA: 5d) 5) Add Canary probe for TLS handshake err rate (owner: maya, ETA: 24h).

net-eng-ana: confirmed I can bump TTLs, will run change at 15:40 UTC. posting change window.

maya: dan ping me when rollback is done, I'll coordinate with oncall to watch metrics.

dan: rollback completed at 14:12 UTC. metrics show TLS err_rate dropping from 6% -> 0.7% over 12 min.

eli: starting the routing-controller guard PR now, will post link when ready for review. small tests pass locally.

sre-bot: Metric alert suppressed: tls-handshake-alert for eu-west-1 suppressed for 30m while mitigations roll out.

maya: for tracking: I've made a tracker spreadsheet and added the triage notes + owners. I'll convert to a weekly digest for the routing reliability board.

dan: one more thing — need retrospective on runbook: current runbook lacked a quick rollback sequence for overlapping prefixes. owner: dan to draft new runbook section (ETA: 4d).

eli: PR link: https://git.redwood/routing/guard-pr-342 — reviewers: @dan @net-eng-ana. includes unit tests and a safety check that rejects publish if prefix covers existing active prefix unless explicit override.

net-eng-ana: TTL bump completed at 15:45 UTC. Verified via dig + curl to edge: hosts return expected edge in us-east-2 now.

maya: follow-ups summary: 1) routing-guard (eli, 2d) 2) runbook updates (dan, 4d) 3) conntrack expansion (infra-team, 5d) 4) TLS canary probe (maya, 24h) 5) weekly digest + postmortem link (maya, 48h). I'll set JIRA tasks and tag owners.

dan: adding a recurring check to our postmortem template: "any routing changes last 72h with TTL < 60s?" — simple checkbox.

eli: note for metrics: we should add a breakdown by source region in the TLS handshake chart, cross-region spikes were the tell. I'll file an observability ticket.

maya: thanks all. if anyone hits blockers with PRs or JIRAs ping here. closing thread for now but will post verification when infra change is complete. :sparkles:
